title: Page<SamplingPlan>
description: The pagination envelope of MOS-API-015 over SamplingPlan, for table 10.2-B row R20. Written out rather than referenced from a generic Page schema because MOS-API-015 says 'MUST be exactly' and closes the object. No total member (MOS-API-016); ordering is MOS-API-018's created_at DESC, id DESC and is not client-selectable, so there is no sort member.

next_cursor.description: MOS-API-017: base64url of a JSON object carrying the sort key, the tie-break id and a fingerprint of the normalised filter set. Opaque; an SDK MUST NOT parse, construct or mutate it. Null when has_more is false.
